doc: FBL 0.11, section 4.9 (comments, rule 2), FR-001: a // or # comment after a statement is its trailing comment and part of no value, so a set changes the bytes of the value's argument only; a // or # inside quotes is part of the string. The input is etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/c4/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.C4.Tests/Fixtures/findings/trailing-comments.dsl at ad1a4680a, byte for byte.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
The comment after the declaration stays where it is.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
A # inside quotes is the value's; the # comment after the statement stays.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
